milestones.title: 2014 Milestones
milestones.intro: In 2014, we launched the 'Love in Cana ~ Catholic Marriage' project in Taiwan. We are grateful for the support of the bishops and priests of various dioceses. From north to south, we communicated with the clergy in one monthly recollection of priests after another across dioceses, receiving great encouragement. At the end of the year, the Catholic marriage website exclusively for Catholics, which had been planned for a long time, finally had its grand opening and officially went online to serve unmarried parishioners throughout Taiwan!

milestones.title: 2015 Milestones
milestones.intro: In 2015, in collaboration with various dioceses, we established a national system of parish Marriage Apostles. Each diocese appointed a Diocesan Director of Marriage Apostles, and each parish appointed a Marriage Apostle to care for the unmarried parishioners in the parish. Over the course of a year, Love in Cana completed the training courses for Marriage Apostles in the dioceses of Kaohsiung, Chiayi, Hsinchu, Taichung, and Taipei. In October, the '1st National Catholic Singles Social Event', hosted by the Family Section of the Chinese Regional Bishops' Conference, co-organized by diocesan family sections and Marriage Apostles, and executed by Love in Cana, concluded successfully and enthusiastically.

events.detail: After visiting and presenting at the monthly recollections of priests in various dioceses, parish priests appointed parish [Marriage Apostles] in the first half of 2015. Subsequently, we went to the dioceses of Taichung, Chiayi, and Kaohsiung to conduct Marriage Apostle training courses.

Brave in pursuit, reaching happiness quickly. The Cana couple Tsai Yao-Ching (蔡耀慶) and Hsieh Wen-Chen (謝汶真) completed the Sacrament of Matrimony at Tianzhong Catholic Church on October 10th.

The Marriage Apostles of the Archdiocese of Taipei were divided into four districts. Cheng Lai-Yi (鄭萊頤) served as the Director of Apostles, and Liu Chung-Hsiu (劉鍾秀), Yu Shu-Chuan (余淑娟), Kao Lin-Yang (高林陽), and Chen Chao-Man (陳昭滿) served as conveners.
The Marriage Apostle system has been established. As of this year, a total of 330 apostles across Taiwan have received training.

milestones.title: 2016 Milestones
milestones.intro: In 2016, mobilized by the Marriage Apostle organizations across Taiwan, more activities and groups for young adults were created. The Catholic Church holds many activities for students, but rarely any exclusively for young adults who have entered society after graduation. Therefore, we organized multiple small-scale singles social events in various regions of Taiwan. This year, more than ten events were held across Taiwan, with a total of 233 youths registered. Among them, the Northern Region held nine small-scale and one medium-scale social events, with about 177 youths participating.

milestones.title: 2018 Milestones
milestones.intro: The focus of Love in Cana's work in 2018 was to root ideal marriage education. The ideal marriage of the Catholic Church is for a Catholic to marry a Catholic. However, because there are so few Catholics, it is indeed not easy to find a Catholic of the same faith in Taiwan. Therefore, many parishioners have long forgotten that this is the Church's ideal marriage. To this end, Love in Cana began operating a parish project this year to renew parishioners' awareness of marriage. The key to this project is the close cooperation among Love in Cana's parish Marriage Apostles, the parish priests, and the parish pastoral councils. Through diverse forms of education, we promote the ideal of Catholic marriage into the hearts of parishioners. Therefore, Love in Cana provides several educational media for parishes. These include educational DVD short films, 'Bi Yi Shuang Fei' (Flying Wing to Wing) monthly magazines, marriage golden quotes, Prayers of the Faithful cards, and prayers for the unmarried, etc.

events.period: Love in Cana Blossoms and Bears Fruit
events.detail: Promoting Catholic marriage, we have heard good news from time to time in recent years. Love in Cana has successively blossomed and borne fruit. Thank God for bringing many Catholic couples together to tie the knot! However, due to certain factors, we cannot learn of every couple's good news one by one. In any case, we wish them all to enjoy the abundant grace of the Sacrament of Matrimony in the Lord.

To attract parish young adults back to the church and to promote cross-parish gatherings and acquaintances among them, youths nominated by nine parishes in New Taipei City formed the Huanbei Young Adults, with a total of 16 core members. Guided by Love in Cana, they design one activity every month.

This year, there were a total of six indoor and outdoor social events, with 104 attendances by unmarried youths. In addition, there were six workshops and study sessions, as well as charity services held every other week, with 71 attendances. The 'Belonging of the Heart' workshop helped youths build more sincere relationships with themselves and others; the MBTI workshop helped youths analyze suitable careers based on their own personalities; while practicing charity, they naturally interacted in the process of accompanying children. These were all follow-up arrangements after the youths' initial acquaintance, with the good intention of further understanding each other's inner selves. In addition to the series of social events, we also conducted personal interviews to understand the individual situations and needs of the youths, thereby providing one-on-one matchmaking services.
